snippet.title: Atari Arcade 2 - Evercade Cartridge Tour
snippet.description:
Captured off the Evercade VS. Despite the title, most of the games were originally by Stern Electronics, now under the ownership by Atari.

Games in this cart:
00:18 - Berzerk
03:23 - Dark Planet
06:12 - Fire Truck
09:57 - Frenzy
13:58 - Lost Tomb
18:10 - Maze Invaders
22:42 - Minefield
24:35 - Moon War
26:46 - Rescue
30:03 - Tazz-Mania

Atari, Berzerk, Dark Planet, Fire Truck, Frenzy, Lost Tomb, Maze Invaders, Minefield, Moon War, Rescue, Tazz-Mania (C) Atari Interactive
